Disconnection fee may apply when vacating your property or if we are required to disconnect your electricity supply. This price is for service in business hours; out of business hours may incur additional fees. Fees are charged by the distributor.

Reconnection fee may apply when reconnecting electricity to your property. This price is for service in business hours; out of business hours may incur additional fees. Fees are charged by the distributor.
